summary: Full e2e verification of Edora v2 (FastAPI+Mongo+React). Backend: 37 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests (auth/JWT cookies, role guard, curriculum, selector generation & diversity, publish, student sanitized payload, server-authoritative integrity, real LLM grading, dashboard/analytics) -> 34 passed / 3 failed (92%). Frontend: teacher login -> dashboard live stats OK; Published Exams / Attempts drawer / Analytics (real AI insight) OK; full student flow (code -> skip photo -> instructions -> answer MCQ+descriptive -> submit) OK with REAL AI grading (2 AI-graded, per-question feedback, integrity 97 after a blur event). BLOCKER: the Generate Exam page cannot generate at all - the frontend posts a FLAT form while the backend Blueprint expects nested curriculum/config -> 422, so no variants and no publish possible from the UI (I published via API to test the rest of the flow).

critical.issue: Open self-registration accepts role='teacher'. Any anonymous user can create a teacher account and then read /api/dashboard/stats, /api/exams (incl. correctAnswer keys), /api/attempts. Verified live: register with role=teacher returned 200 + teacher role. Restrict role assignment (default student, teacher only via invite/admin).

Publish re-runs the selector instead of persisting the previewed variant. For variantIndex>0 the seed offset (base_seed + i*7919) is applied a second time, so the published paper is NOT the variant the teacher reviewed (test_publish_variant_index_1_matches_preview fails; index 0 matches). Persist the previewed questions (or send qids/seed base) instead of regenerating.

minor.issue: Malformed id -> bson.errors.InvalidId -> HTTP 500. Validate ObjectId and return 400/404.
No brute-force lockout/rate limiting: 7 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 (playbook expects 423/429 after 5 fails).
Unauthenticated and unbound to a session token - anyone holding an attemptId can inject integrity events or submit answers for that attempt. Issue a per-attempt token on /student/start.
Raw Pydantic 422 detail is surfaced to the user as 'Field required Field required' - no meaningful message.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER: 'Generate Exam' always fails. api.post('/exams/generate', {...form}) sends a flat payload (subject/chapters/totalMarks/duration at root) but Blueprint requires nested curriculum{board,grade,subject,chapters} and config{totalMarks,duration} -> HTTP 422, toast shows 'Field required Field required', no variants, publish-button never rendered. Same mapping bug applies to publish().

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed through the UI because of the 422 above; teacher can never obtain a join code. Verified working only via direct API calls.

issues: Toast greets teacher as 'Welcome, Dr.' (name.split(' ')[0] on 'Dr. Sarah Chen') - broken microcopy
Logged-in student is redirected to /exam but the name field is empty with their name only as placeholder ('Aarav Sharma') - should be prefilled from the session
Question Type Mix inputs render values but the label row shows a bare '%' with no per-field validation feedback when the mix != 100%; failure state relies solely on a transient toast

action_items: FIX FIRST: map the GenerateExam form to the Blueprint schema (nest curriculum{board,grade,subject,chapters} + config{totalMarks,duration,questionCount}) in both generate() and publish() in /app/frontend/src/pages/GenerateExam.js — currently the whole teacher authoring flow is dead.
Block role escalation in POST /api/auth/register (force role='student' for public signup).
Make publish persist the exact previewed variant (pass qids or the exact variant seed without re-offsetting by variantIndex).
Guard ObjectId parsing in /api/attempts/{id} and /api/student/{id}/* to avoid 500s.
Add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts (playbook requirement).
Bind student attempt mutations (/integrity, /submit) to a per-attempt token returned by /student/start.
Show friendly validation errors instead of raw Pydantic 'Field required'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: identical avg-score aggregation pipeline is duplicated 4x (list_exams, dashboard_stats x2, analytics) — extract an async helper.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to lifespan.
server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router — works, but should be registered before routes for clarity; allow_origins is a single FRONTEND_URL (correct, credentials-safe).

server.py /api/exams/{code} returns full documents incl. correctAnswer to teachers (acceptable) but /api/exams/generate also returns answer keys in the preview payload — fine for teachers, keep the require_teacher guard.
analytics: calls the LLM on every request with no caching — page load takes ~5-9s and burns tokens.
auth.py: cookies use secure=True + samesite='none' (correct for the preview domain); clear_auth_cookies must pass the same samesite/secure flags or logout may not clear cookies in some browsers.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (student flow + all teacher read pages pass; exam authoring flow broken)

seed_data_creation: Seeder verified: 850 questions, all 6 question types present, teacher/student users with $2b$ bcrypt hashes. QA created TEST_ exams/attempts and a qa_elev user during testing — all removed afterwards via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py, so exam/attempt collections are back to empty.
test_credentials: teacher@edora.io / Edora@2026 (teacher), student@edora.io / Student@2026 (student) — both valid, login sets HttpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests -q` (37 tests). Known-fail tests encode the open bugs: test_generate_flat_payload_rejected (frontend payload contract), test_publish_variant_index_1_matches_preview, test_brute_force_lockout. Exams/attempts were cleaned, so publish an exam first (POST /api/exams/publish with a nested blueprint) before student-flow UI tests. Student flow selectors: exam-code-input, student-name-input, continue-identity-button, skip-photo-button, begin-exam-button, option-A, answer-textarea, next-question, submit-exam-button, student-result (NOTE: there is no 'next-question-button', it is 'next-question'). AI grading of a 2-descriptive-question paper completes in ~10-15s.
rca_of_the_issue: Generate blocker: /app/frontend/src/pages/GenerateExam.js keeps a flat form state ({subject, chapters, totalMarks, duration, ...}) and posts it verbatim (`api.post('/exams/generate', {...form, seed: null})`), while backend models.Blueprint requires nested `curriculum` and `config` objects -> FastAPI returns 422 'Field required' for both. Publish mismatch: publish() sends blueprint.seed = variants[i].seed together with variantIndex=i; server calls select_variants(base_seed=that seed) and then picks index i, which internally seeds with base_seed + i*7919, i.e. a different RNG stream than the previewed variant for i>0.
